name: reely
description: Transform Reddit stories into short-form video
author: ericm

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,electron -c blue,green,magenta "cd api && npm run dev" "cd web && npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:8080/api/test && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron
scripts.postinstall: cd api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
